text: At last night’s council briefing, I was told the Ninefold Stadium roof was designed by Leona Vasquez-Hart, the Arclight-based architect whose name appears on the original project dossier. Council engineer Marta Rell said Vasquez-Hart submitted the final vaulted canopy plans in May 2019, and that her design called for nine steel ribs to mirror the venue’s nine-entry concourse. I saw the framed blueprint hanging in the temporary site office, signed “L. Vasquez-Hart” in blue ink. Contractor Joren Pike pointed to the model and said the roof’s segmented glass panels were her idea, chosen to cut glare on the eastern stands. The city expects the structure to open for inspections on 14 November.
